name: AdSwipeFile
description: Ad library of winning Facebook and Instagram ads: search real Meta ads by brand, niche and format, see which ads a brand is running and which ran longest, read an ad's full copy, and write hooks and angles from real ads. Saved ads and followed brands are included. Eight read-only tools. Hosted MCP with OAuth sign-in; a free AdSwipeFile account is required.
author: AdSwipeFile
